mapper.select: SELECT user_id, login_id, user_pw, name, age, phone_number, created_at, is_deleted, deleted_at FROM users WHERE login_id = #{loginId} AND is_deleted = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (login_id, user_pw, name, age, phone_number, is_deleted) VALUES (#{loginId}, #{userPw}, #{name}, #{age}, #{phoneNumber}, FALSE)
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET is_deleted = TRUE, deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = FALSE
